hero.overline: आज की पेशी, कल की तैयारी।
hero.sub: Cause lists, cases, clients and invoices — synced from the court record by CNR and delivered to your WhatsApp every evening. Built for Indian courts, free to begin.

evening.title: Tomorrow's peshi, on WhatsApp before 8 pm.
evening.body: Every evening your full cause list for tomorrow — court, item number, stage — arrives where you already are. No portal logins, no calls to the clerk.

fee.title: Invoices that file themselves.
fee.body: Hours become GST-ready invoices; clients pay by UPI, card or netbanking. The cash-and-diary fee book, respectfully retired.

pricing.title: Priced like one consultation.
pricing.note: Per lawyer / month, billed annually · monthly +25%
pricing.founding: Founding members: Pro at ₹399/mo for your first 12 months.

footer.tagline: Making Indian litigation legible — for the advocates who run it and the citizens who live through it.
footer.compliance: Case data is sourced from public court records and refreshed daily. Peshi is practice software and a neutral directory; it does not rank, recommend or endorse advocates. © 2026 Peshi.
